title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the induced EMF in coil A using Faraday's law with the given number of turns, area, and rate of change of magnetic field.

title: Steady-state current calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the steady-state current through R2 using Ohm's law for the complete series circuit (EMF, r, R1, R2).

title: Voltage across capacitor
description: Important: Correctly determines the voltage across the capacitor (equal to the voltage across R2) using Ohm's law with the steady-state current.

title: Capacitor charge calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the charge stored on the capacitor using Q = C*U for part (2).

title: Circuit analysis after S1 disconnect
description: Important: Recognizes that after S1 is disconnected, the capacitor discharges through the loop containing R2 and possibly other elements, and the charge passing through R2 equals the capacitor's initial stored charge.

title: Area selection for flux
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong area (e.g., coil area instead of region D area) when calculating the magnetic flux change.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in induced EMF direction (Lenz's law) for current direction, or a unit conversion error (e.g., microfarads).

title: Equivalent resistance mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly combines resistances (e.g., treating R1 and R2 as parallel) when calculating the total circuit resistance for the steady-state current.
